title: Joseph of Copertino levitating during Mass

tellings.quote: right Joseph of copertino was a 17th century friend Franciscan frier that would experience ecstatic Visions as a child and many people witnessed him levitating while participating in Mass

plain: Joseph of Copertino was a Franciscan friar in 17th century Italy who had ecstatic visions from childhood, and many people saw him float off the ground while taking part in Mass. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as an example of a strange event recorded in religious history.
